_doc: Recovery phrase derivation (packages/client-core/src/crypto/bip39.ts). The phrase is trimmed, lowercased and its whitespace runs collapsed to one space, then checked as a BIP-39 English mnemonic (word list and checksum). seed = BIP-39 seed (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations, salt 'mnemonic', no passphrase). wrap_key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = seed, salt = account salt bytes, info = 'atlas-recovery-v1', 32 bytes): it wraps the recovery slots. auth_secret_key = the same with info 'atlas-recovery-auth-v1', an X25519 secret whose public half the server seals recovery challenges to. Hex is lowercase. `invalid` lists phrases that must be refused. Asserted by packages/client-core/src/crypto/recovery-vectors.test.ts and crates/atlas-client.
